name: accordion
behavior: APG accordion pattern (trigger is a button inside a heading, aria-expanded + aria-controls; Enter/Space toggle; Tab moves through triggers — arrow-key trigger navigation is optional per APG)

parts.note: bottom rule between items; last item drops it
height animates between 0 and content height; overflow hidden during transition

anatomyNotes: Single-open vs multi-open is a behavior option declared on the root, not a variant axis. shadcn places the indicator trailing, Salt leading — indicator position is a recipe difference, same part.
